tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the backdrop gradient (Scene, page hero). Midday blue in Light, night sky in Dark, white in Technozen.

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the backdrop, placed at 55%.

tokens.name: sky-bottom
tokens.usage: Horizon stop of the backdrop: pale haze, teal horizon glow, soft grey.

tokens.name: horizon-glow
tokens.usage: Light source color for the backdrop: sun flare in Light, aurora curtains in Dark, cool daylight in Technozen.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells behind content: sidebars, track backgrounds, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Flat page ground when no backdrop is painted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid content layer: panel bodies, tiles, fields, cards. Body text sits here.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs: the top layer, always with shadow-popover.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and item hover wash on surface-raised and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or item. Pair with a 2px accent marker or check, never color alone.

tokens.name: pinstripe
tokens.usage: Second color of the 2px pinstripe texture, repeating with surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent panels over a backdrop, always with blur-glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for toolbars, docks and panels over busy imagery.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px lit rim on glass and gloss.

tokens.name: glass-shine
tokens.usage: Curved shine across the top of glass panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token and on sky-bottom.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-overlay, surface-hover and surface-selected (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and timestamps. Meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised; not for essential text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on solid dark or saturated fills: tooltips in Light, danger buttons.

tokens.name: on-gloss
tokens.usage: Labels and glyphs on bright gloss tones (aqua, water, grass, sun) in every theme.

tokens.name: on-pearl
tokens.usage: Labels on the neutral pearl gloss. Pearl is light glass in Light and Technozen and smoked glass in Dark, so this flips.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons on surface, surface-raised and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover, with underline.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Control borders: fields, toggles, tiles, checkboxes (3:1+ on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasized borders: selected tile, active tab underline.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative separators between rows and sections. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Solid interactive color: checkbox fill, selected marker, slider fill, active tab.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent on hover.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Accent on press.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Accent wash: selected chips, info rows, focus-within backgrounds. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Glyphs and text on a solid accent fill.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px. 3:1+ on every backdrop stop and surface of its theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and marker color.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success message background.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Success message text on success-bg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon and marker color.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning message background.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning message text on warning-bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive color: danger button fill, error icon, invalid field border.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error message background.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Error message text on danger-bg.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info icon and marker color.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info message background.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Info message text on info-bg.

tokens.name: aqua-100
tokens.usage: Lit highlight of aqua gloss and orbs.

tokens.name: aqua-300
tokens.usage: Lit half of aqua gloss; hover tint.

tokens.name: aqua-500
tokens.usage: Signature sky blue: primary gloss body, the lead cover block. Label with on-gloss.

tokens.name: aqua-700
tokens.usage: Aqua rims and pressed stop.

tokens.name: aqua-900
tokens.usage: Deep ocean: orb edge shading, dark headings on bright glass.

tokens.name: water-300
tokens.usage: Shallow water: caustics, bubble rims, water gloss top.

tokens.name: water-500
tokens.usage: Clear water: droplets, the Water scene, water gloss body. Label with on-gloss.

tokens.name: water-700
tokens.usage: Deep water shading and water gloss rim.

tokens.name: grass-100
tokens.usage: Lit highlight of grass gloss.

tokens.name: grass-300
tokens.usage: Sunlit grass: hill crest, grass gloss mid.

tokens.name: grass-500
tokens.usage: Signature green: go actions, progress. Label with on-gloss.

tokens.name: grass-700
tokens.usage: Grass rims and the shaded foot of hills.

tokens.name: sun-300
tokens.usage: Lens-flare glow and sunlit bloom.

tokens.name: sun-500
tokens.usage: The sun: flare core, starburst badges. Label with on-gloss.

tokens.name: sun-700
tokens.usage: Warm rim of the sun, goldfish and badge edges.

tokens.name: aurora-green
tokens.usage: Aurora curtains and Dark's accent glow.

tokens.name: aurora-teal
tokens.usage: Bloom rising from hovered orbs; lower edge of aurora curtains.

tokens.name: pearl-100
tokens.usage: Top of the neutral pearl gloss: light glass in Light and Technozen, smoked glass in Dark.

tokens.name: pearl-300
tokens.usage: Middle of the pearl gloss.

tokens.name: pearl-500
tokens.usage: Lower half of the pearl gloss. Label with on-pearl.

tokens.name: chrome-100
tokens.usage: Y2K layer: bright band of chrome.

tokens.name: chrome-500
tokens.usage: Y2K layer: dark band of chrome, set in a hard stripe with chrome-100.

tokens.name: bondi
tokens.usage: Y2K layer: translucent candy-plastic accent (Bondi Blue, common hex value).

families.aero: "Segoe UI", Selawik, Frutiger, Hind, "Lucida Grande", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines on a Scene, in ink directly on the backdrop. Light and airy.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs under a display or title line. Semilight, the signature Vista-era weight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your photos are backed up and ready to share.

styles.name: zen-title
styles.usage: Friendly rounded titles for Technozen screens and Tiles: family, play, home.

styles.name: zen-clock
styles.usage: The big ambient clock or single number on a Technozen home screen.

styles.name: y2k-tag
styles.usage: Uppercase techno stamps and version tags. Short strings only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gloss inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding, tile inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between panels; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Scene padding around hero content. Aero layouts breathe: leave sky showing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields and the progress track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles and small panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels and cards: soft, pebble-like corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Gel buttons, toggles, search fields, badges and orbs.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating glass panels.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips and dialogs on surface-overlay.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting tiles and cards.

tokens.name: shadow-gloss
tokens.usage: Every gloss surface at rest: lit rim, caustic bounce, contact shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-orb
tokens.usage: Orbs and knobs: light inside the sphere, drop to the floor.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: fields, tracks.

tokens.name: glow-aqua
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-within bloom on aqua and pearl controls.

tokens.name: glow-grass
tokens.usage: Hover bloom on grass controls.

tokens.name: glow-aurora
tokens.usage: Bloom around hovered orbs and the Spinner.

blur.note: Backdrop blur. Aero glass is clear with a light frost; heavy blur reads as 2025 Liquid Glass.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on glass panels.

tokens.name: blur-soft
tokens.usage: Soft-focus imagery layers: clouds, bokeh, ribbon glow.

tokens.name: gloss-line
tokens.usage: Where the lit half ends on pill gloss (hard stop at the same percentage both sides).

tokens.name: shine-height
tokens.usage: Height of the white shine layer on gel buttons and orbs, inset from the top edge.
